name: Verdant Sanctum gameplay
state: In progress: slices 1-4 and the parry merged; the seeded tuning step in review; slice 5 (the Rootbinder) built on its branch
summary: The owner rejected the Verdant gameplay a third time on 2026-11-20: the shared Verdant base is slop, move visuals linger after the move, and Verdant leans on tells far more than any other boss. Verdant's boss, enemies and stage are rebuilt from scratch in the pattern of Aldric, the Echo and the Colossus, keeping only the approved Rootbound seed-pod figure and the drawn background. Measured on main 6fb1a7cd: a scripted player takes 2.8, 1.1 and 0 hits per 10 s from today's Rootbound across its three phases, against 4 to 7 from the reference bosses; its Phase III does not move; its two phase cinematics block 12.9 s of a 37 s fight; it draws 16 tell marks against Aldric's 6. The plan adds two rules over every boss and enemy (nothing outlives its move, tell weight) and builds the new Verdant on the engineering channel until the owner approves it on preview.
next: The tuning step on the seeded sample (twelve seeds since #394): the Second Swing aims once as its coil starts, through a shared aim field (move-aim.ts, Pale next), with a tell long enough that a dash spent as it starts is back in time; the new boss declares its tells from the same vine data as its hit test; health 3000 brings the Phase I clear into band; Phase III's clear target is re-based directly from the references. The clears sit in band; the scripted hits stay under band in every phase, open: the lead decides the design from the split of the references' hits by source. Then slice 5, the new Rootbinder. The plan's 6.1 is the handoff.
